description: Assign, reassign, or clear the asset in a landing-page or side-page slot. slotKey is a dotted key like 'hero.backgroundVideo' or 'cta.image' (discover valid keys with list_asset_slots). For array slots pass assetIds; for single slots pass assetId. The asset must already be in the brand's library (see list_assets / upload_asset / import_asset_from_url) and match the slot's media type. Pass sidePageSlug to target a side page. Set clear:true (or assetId:null) to empty the slot. Synchronous — the change applies immediately, no polling. Main-LP changes create a new draft version.

assetId.description: Asset ID for a single (non-array) slot. Pass null to clear the slot.

assetIds.description: Asset IDs for an array slot. Pass an empty array (or null) to clear the slot.

clear.description: Set true to empty the slot

pageKey.description: Page key within the LP (defaults to 'main'; ignored when sidePageSlug is set)

sidePageSlug.description: Side page slug — target this side page's slot instead of the main LP's

slotKey.description: Dotted slot key, e.g. 'hero.backgroundVideo' or 'cta.image' (from list_asset_slots)

name: assign_asset_to_slot
